$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. ThreadEvent is the wire shape for the five new dev.aarso.domain.mirror.AarsoEventKind values THREAD_TOPOLOGY_PLAN.md's Data model section names verbatim (FORK_CREATED, SPAWN_CREATED, CHAPTER_MARK, SESSION_START, DELEGATION), carried as a ContractEnvelope<ThreadEvent> payload (FB-RAT-COM-011) — same relationship EnvelopeCodecTest exercises for ErrorEnvelope. Per binding constraint 3 (Issue #2): AarsoEventLog stays write-only and this schema documents its APPEND shape only; nothing here computes, interprets, or reads the log back — no §5b/§5c drift logic. The DELEGATION variant's outcome/outcomeAt fields double as the wire shape for THREAD_TOPOLOGY_PLAN.md's separate `delegation_events` Room table (dev.aarso.data.DelegationStore) — one JSON shape, two consumers (the inert append-only log, and the queryable Room store), deliberately not duplicated into a fourth schema file.
title: ThreadEvent
description: One thread-topology event: a fork/spawn creation, a chapter mark, a session-start mark, or a delegation ('choose for me') record. Which of the kind-specific field groups below is populated (and required) is fixed structurally by `kind`, mirroring schemas/workspace/buffer-journal-entry.schema.json's opType-conditional field pattern.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this record's shape. A reader MUST reject an unrecognized MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

eventId.description: Globally unique stable id for this event (FB-RAT-COM-002).

kind.description: THREAD_TOPOLOGY_PLAN.md's five new AarsoEventKind values, verbatim.

rootId.description: The conversation root this event concerns, when it concerns exactly one (null for a DELEGATION event not yet tied to a specific conversation, e.g. a loop-gateway auto-choice).

anchorMsgId.description: The message this event anchors to, when applicable.

srcRootId.description: FORK_CREATED/SPAWN_CREATED only: the source conversation root being forked/spawned from (mirrors the plan's `lineage.srcRoot` insert-time metadata key on the new root's first node).

srcNodeId.description: FORK_CREATED/SPAWN_CREATED only: the exact source node the new subtree/bridge was created from (mirrors `lineage.srcNode`).

newRootId.description: FORK_CREATED/SPAWN_CREATED only: the new conversation root's id.

markerId.description: CHAPTER_MARK/SESSION_START only: the dev.aarso.domain.thread.ThreadMarker.id this event records the creation of — the event log and the marker row are two independent facts about the same action (write-only log vs. queryable store), correlated by this id.

label.description: CHAPTER_MARK only: the chapter's label at creation time, required non-blank.

delegationId.description: DELEGATION only: the dev.aarso.domain.thread.DelegationEvent.id this event records.

delegationKind.description: DELEGATION only: which of the four 'choose for me' surfaces produced this delegation (owner decision 2, THREAD_TOPOLOGY_PLAN.md — model-picks-at-branch-point, council auto-merge acceptance, loop gateway auto-choice, accepted auto-default; one unified concept).

chosenRef.description: DELEGATION only: a reference to what was chosen (e.g. the branch/model/edge-label id the delegation selected).

alternatives.description: DELEGATION only: the other options that were available but not chosen, for descriptive display — never used for §5b/§5c interpretation (binding constraint 3).

outcome.description: DELEGATION only: PENDING at creation; KEPT/REVERTED once dev.aarso.domain.thread.DelegationOutcomes.correlate (a later work package) resolves it. Tracked descriptively only, per owner decision 2 — 'kept-vs-reverted tracked descriptively only.'

outcomeAt.description: DELEGATION only: UTC instant `outcome` last changed. Null while PENDING.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

allOf.$comment: A resolved outcome MUST carry the instant it resolved — PENDING (or absent/null) is the only state that leaves outcomeAt null.
